title: Zol
description: Defeat a Zol. During the Tri Power tutorial on Suthorn Beach, throw a rock at the green Zol. Uses: - Attack: Small monster that hops at enemies

title: Sea Urchin
description: Defeat a Sea Urchin. During the Tri Power tutorial on Suthorn Beach, throw a rock at the sea urchin. Uses: - Attack/Defense: Immobile spiky monster that harms anything that touches it

title: Keese
description: Defeat a Keese. Inside [Beach Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401486), create a Rock Echo and then toss it at the Keese as it swoops down to kill it. Uses: - Traversal: Hold to float off ledges - Attack: Small flying monster that can dive-bombs enemies

title: Sign
description: East of Suthorn Village, grab the wooden sign along the dirt path. Uses: - You can read the sign. It says, "WARNING: This sign is made out of wood, which is flammable."

title: Trampoline
description: In the the center of Suthorn Village, next to [Bottom of the Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401481). Uses: - Traversal: Reach slightly greater heights with this bouncy platform

title: Pot
description: Use an Old Bed or Trampoline to jump into [Bottom of the Well](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401481) at the center of Suthorn Village. Pots can also be found in most homes within Suthorn Village. Uses: - Attack: Can be thrown at enemies

title: Ignizol
description: Defat an Ignizol. Inside [Suthorn Forest Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401482) is a short path to the Ignizol, which is a small blob that's on fire. You'll need to throw a pot to douse its flames and kill it. A rock will work, but it'll take much longer to defeat. Uses: - Traversal: Light torches and solve puzzles - Attack: Sets enemies on fire.

title: Rope
description: Defeat a Rope. Use an Ignizol echo to burn the grass hiding a green snake-like monster. Throw a rock at the enemy to learn the Rope echo. Uses: - Attack: rushes at enemies; capable of dodging airborne enemy attacks

title: Caromadillo
description: Defeat a Caromadillo. Inside [Suthorn Forest - Cave 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401478), you can find the armadillo-like enemy rolling between two ledges. Drop an attack-type echo into the pit to defeat the monster. Uses: - Attack: Turns into a ball and rams enemies; bounces off walls to change direction

title: Table
description: Your first echo, in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon jail cell. Uses: - Traversal: Small platform that can be pushed or stacked

title: Old Bed
description: After Impa gives you the log, you are free to exit the Hyrule Castle Dungeon via the top of bookshelves storing... these beds. Uses: - Traversal: Long platform that can be stacked - Healing: Interact with bed to sleep and restore hearts

title: Wooden Box
description: Your second echo, in the Hyrule Castle dungeon escape tutorial. Uses: - Traversal: Large platform that can be stacked - Attack: Can be thrown at enemies

title: Decorative Shrub
description: After Impa gives you the log, you are free to exit the Hyrule Castle Dungeon and will find this in the hallway after you see her. Uses: - Traversal: Tall plant that can be used as a high platform to cross ledges

title: Boulder
description: In the Royal Family Shortcut as you escape Hyrule Castle Dungeon a boulder blocks your way. Learn this echo and then push the boulder into the water. Use the boulder to way down the crates and escape. Uses: - Traversal: Creates a heavy rock, can be used to sink platforms below water

title: Rock
description: On the beach as you escape the Royal Family Shortcut. Uses: - Attack: Creates a small stone that can be thrown at enemies

title: Meat
description: In the house in the southwestern corner of Suthorn Village, the meat echo roasts over the fireplace. Uses: - Lure: Creates a large slab of meat that can be used to lure monsters

title: Spear Moblin
description: Defeat a Spear Moblin. In the central part of the Suthorn Forest you can find these pig-men with spears, the Spear Moblin. It can be defeated for the Spear Moblin Echo by throwing various monster echos at it (such as the Caromadillo) or rock echoes. Uses: - Attack: Creates a large monster that can throw spears at opponents

title: Peahat
description: Defeat a Peahat. Inside [Suthorn Forest Cave 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401478). It's recommend to get the Spear Moblin Echo before taking it on. When it stops spinning, the Spear Moblins (it will take a few) can spear it. Just leave them and RUN AWAY. Alternatively, you can take a riskier route and throw Rock Echoes at it while it spins. Uses: - Attack: Creates a large floating enemy that spins its appendages to cut anything nearby

title: Sword Moblin
description: Defeat a Sword Moblin. Tucked away behind trees on the west side of Zora River (and west of the big rift) lurks this Moblin with some of its fierce allies. Wolfos can be effective against Moblins because of its quick attacks that counter Moblin's slower movements. Another early Sword Moblin location is just southeast of the Suthorn Ruins, south of a stamp pedestal. Uses: - Attack: Large monster that attacks enemies with a sword

title: Mini-Moldorm
description: Defeat a Mini-Moldorm. The overworld-dwelling monster called the Mini Moldorm that moves like a sort of crazy caterpillar or snake can be slayed just southeast of the Suthorn Ruins, south of a stamp pedestal. This area is quite high up, so you'll need to build to reach it. Uses: - Combat

title: Crawltula
description: Defeat a Crawltula. The first you'll see is likely just north of Suthorn Village. As soon as it spots you from its spot on a pillar it'll scuttle over, so be ready! We recommend using a Darknut to defeat it. The Crawltula's attacks don't hurt Darknut and the Darknut's attacks will vanquish the spider-like monster quickly. You can also use a Peahat or other strong monster echo. Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Crow
description: Defeat a Crow. Crows sit atop trees in the Hyrule Field area north of Lake Hylia and at the eastern entrance to Gerudo Desert. Use a swarm of Keese or other flying monsters to take it down! Uses: - On its first hit it'll knock rupees out of its target!

title: Aruroda
description: Defeat an Aruroda. These desert dwelling cyclops scorpions can be found in the Gerudo Desert, the first you encounter are in the sand along the south wall. They dive beneath the sand and can be killed with other surface echoes like Crawtula or Mini Moldorm. Sea Urchin are nicely effective against them too. Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Sand Piranha
description: Defeat a Sand Piranha. These desert fish dive to avoid your basic attacks but are easy to fry up with an echo of just about any common monster. Uses: - Combat (sand)

title: Tornando
description: Defeat a Tornando. Be wary that the Tornando warps back to its starting position as it whirlwind-attacks you. Just leave a Crawtula around to take care of it quickly. Uses: - Push enemies away with whirlwind spin

title: Club Boarblin
description: Defeat a Club Boarblin. Just northeast of the huge rift in the Gerudo Desert is a chest on a platform with a ladder locked away by Club Boarblin and Boomerang Boarblin. You can defeat them with tough enemies like a Peahat or Darknut Echoes. The Crawltula will aggressively go after them too! Uses: - Combat

title: ReDead
description: Defeat a ReDead. South of Gerudo Desert Oasis are some ruins and a small hut with ReDead, a screaming zombie that paralyzes you. They are tough to kill, so try to bring a Crawtula to help. Leave a Crawtula or another tough enemy near the ReDead and keep away! It will paralyze every Echo and you with its scream, so leave some distance so you can escape. Uses: - Combat. Will freeze nearby enemies.

title: Wind Cannon
description: Inside [Gerudo Desert Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401485) there are gusts of wind blowing you off the path—stop them with a Boulder Echo. Make your way to the cannon and put a Boulder Echo in front of it and push it towards the Wind Cannon to claim it. Uses: - Push enemies or objects back with wind - Clear away sand heaps

title: Ball-and-Chain Trooper
description: Defeat Ball-and-Chain Trooper. During your return to [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402417) (B2), after passing through your prison cell, you will have to complete some stealth areas. After this you will get a small key and turn up on the east side of the dungeon where you can fight the Ball and Chain Trooper. Spawn some Echoes and get right close to it with sword attacks to win this one. Uses: - Combat

title: Holmill
description: Defeat a Holmill. Inside [Ancestor's Cave of Rest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401493), move the massive Boulder to the left to reveal a doorway. Behind it is a room with two Holmill. To kill them, summon an enemy Echo and then use X to latch on to them so they don't disappear while your Echo attacks! Uses: - Create tunnel to descend to lower levels - Dig for treasure

title: Octorok
description: Defeat an Octorok. These weaker water foes aren't too hard to knock out with a few Keese (one will likely get knocked out before it lands its attack) and/or a Spear Moblin. The Spear Moblin don't always have the best aim, but they'll get the job done eventually. Uses: - Combat

title: Gerudo Pot
description: [Gerudo Desert Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401485), past the gusts of wind that can be blocked with a Boulder Echo. Uses: - Use as platform - Combat: throw at enemies - Jump into pot to hide

title: Zelda's Bed
description: Found in [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402417) after healing the rift. Uses: - Platform - Rest in bed to heal hearts

title: Gustmaster
description: Found during your return to [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402417). Uses: - Use the gusts to propel Zelda up to high platforms

title: Darknut, Lv. 2
description: Found during your return to [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402417) (1F). Uses: - Combat

title: Electric Wizzrobe
description: A potent electricity wielder, this creature warps across the sky, firing lighting-fast bolts that shock targets. Uses: - Combat

title: Buzz Blob
description: In the water Uses: - Needed to beat Faron temple - Useful in the water against foes

title: Grilled Fish
description: Begin [Deliver the Grilled Fish!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402595) to receive a Grilled Fish from Anube's Mother. Uses: - Lure

title: Brazier
description: Outside the [Suthorn Forest Cave 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401478) entrance. Uses: - Source of fire

title: Tangler, Lv. 2
description: Inside [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401518), dive down into the deep water. Follow the underwater caves to the right until you reach the fish-type Echo. Uses: - Underwater Combat

title: Chompfin
description: Aggressive water-type Echo, swimming around the ship ruins. Uses: - Water Combat

title: Hydrozol
description: Inside [Zora Cove Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401529). The entrance to the Faron Wetlands from the west holds another Hydrozol. Uses: - Put out fires

title: Flying Tile
description: Inside [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401492). Uses: - Projectile

title: Spark
description: Found inside [Eastern Temple](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401528) while completing [Let's Play a Game](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402662) (Side Quest). Uses: - shock-type damage

title: Carrot
description: Found after healing the Carrot Patch during [Impa's Gift](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402680). Uses: - Summon Horse

title: Firework
description: Reward for completing [The Fireworks Artist](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402709) (Side Quest). Uses: - ??

title: Bombfish
description: Defeat a Bombfish. Found in the water within [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402730). Uses: Destroy cracked rocks and walls

title: Needlefly
description: Dragonfly-looking monster flying above the water's surface. Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Sword Moblin, Lv. 2
description: Echo localizado em hyrule.

title: Spiked Roller
description: The main obstacle inside [West Hyrule Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401510).

title: Biri
description: Floating in the water. Uses: - Attacks with electric field. Extended reach in water.

title: Guay
description: Soaring implacably above Hyrule Field, this winged monster dives to attack prey with its sharp beak. Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Drippitune
description: Blue toad singing on a tree stump. Blue toad sitting on tree stump Uses: - Song makes it rain

title: Lizalfos
description: Green bipedal monster that hides in the grass. Uses: - Combat

title: Hoarder
description: In Scrubton, there are many fallen tree logs with glowing blue mushrooms. Some of the mushrooms are actually Hoarder monsters in disguise.

title: Piranha
description: Swimming in the water. Uses: - Water Combat

title: Wolfos
description: Wolf-like monster that circles its prey before dashing to attack. Uses: - Combat

title: Lynel
description: When you first enter the Eternal Forest, head northwest to find the beginning of the hoof print trail leading to the Lynel clearing. This is one of the strongest combat Echoes in the entire game. It's highly recommended to stock-up on damage-reduction accessories and smoothies to prep for the fight. Most combat-type Echoes won't live long enough against the Lynel, so you'll need to rely on Swordfighter Form to deal significant damage. Head to [Lueburry](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402470) to upgrade your gauge and weapon. Will need minimum Tri lv9 to be summonable.

title: Boomerang Boarblin
description: Trained in the use of boomerangs, this Boarblin Warrior is dangerous both coming and going. Uses: - Combat

title: Gibdo
description: The lower level version of the mummy-like monster, found inside [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401487)

title: Gibdo, Lv. 2
description: The upgraded version of the Gibdo, found in the later areas of [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401487)

title: Ice Wizzrobe
description: "A mighty caster of ice magic, this creature warps across the sky, freezing enemies with frigid blasts" Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Stuffed Toy
description: Inside the Hyrule Cemetery Underground. Light up the two braziers to open the secret passage. The Stuffed Toy sits in the cave inside, on top of crates. Uses: - Attracts Ghosts

title: Tweelus
description: This fire-resistant rock monster's hard body is still vulnerable to impact. It has a weakness for rock roast. Uses: - Fire resistance. - Stepping stones across shallow lava.

title: Caromadillo Lv. 2
description: Inside the cave. Defeat the Desert Caromadillo. Best done with a an attack-typ echo that is ammune to blunt force attacks, like the Darknut. Uses: - ?? - ??

title: Armos Echo
description: This living statue tirelessly patrols back and forth in a straight path, never wavering, always facing directly ahead. To defeat, grab with bind and pull to turn around and expose its vulnerable back. Uses: - Push enemies forward and off ledges - Use as living statues to trigger switches

title: Soft Bed
description: In the Mango Lab in the Gerudo Desert you can acquire a... fancier purple bed. Note that this bed takes 2 Echo power bits to use but you recover twice as fast when you sleep in it. Uses: - Platform - Sleep in the bed to recover hearts

title: Hyrule Castle Pot
description: The Hyrule Castle Pot is your third echo, found in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon escape tutorial. Uses: - Use as a platform - Jump into the pot to hide

title: Lava Rock
description: Outside of the Rock-Roast Quarry is a lava pool with this flat, wide, lava-proof rock floating in it. Uses: - Use as a floating platform

title: Ice Block
description: You will encounter the Ice Block as part of [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610) (Main Quest). Entering the cave behind Conde's house, you will come to a room full of ice spikes and crates. Burn them all with Ignizol Echo to reveal a passage in the rear right hand corner to a room full of Ice Blocks. Uses: - Block that can be pushed - Floating platform

title: Snowball Echo
description: Hebra Mountain holds many giant rolling snowballs. You first encounter them in the cave by Conde's house, but they appear nearly everywhere near the peak. Approach one and mash R2 to capture its echo! You can stop them from rolling with L2 / X. Uses: - Use in combat, rolls down hills

title: Rock Roast
description: The Rock-Roast Quarry is a rift area in Eldin Volcano. Inside here you'll find Rock Roast as part of the main quest. Uses: - Used in the main quest

title: Water Block
description: You'll collect this unusual object echo while in the [Stilled Jabul Waters](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403467) as part of The Jabul Water Rift main quest. Uses: - Create and stack water blocks that you can swim through

title: Elephant Statue
description: After passing through a subterranean passage to the northeast tip of 1F in the Gerudo Sanctum, you will come to a room with conveyor belts and fire. Use Boulder Echoes to block the fire and reach the Elephant Statue in the upper right corner. An impressive statue with a long trunk and polished tusks. Its knowing eyes stare into the distance. Uses: - Quest item - Place on switches

title: Hawk Statue
description: The Stilled Gerudo Sanctum is the outside area you reach from 1F. On the far eastern / rightmost side of this area is a treacherous path upwards and then three dark ReDeads to fight. After all of this, a large column with a ladder above is at a seeming dead end. Use a Tornando Echo to move the sand piles near its bottom and that will reveal the hook you can latch onto with the ZL / X grab power. Pull it to the right by attaching with X and walking right to align the ladder. Atop is the Hawk Statue. Uses: - Place on switches - Quest item

title: Cat Statue
description: After re-entering the Gerudo Sanctum - 1F from the external area called the Stilled Gerudo Sanctum, you'll have to cross some quicksand through a time door -- on the other side is a room full of Gibdo and ReDead. Light them all aflame with Ignizol Echoes and wait for them to burn. Now, collect your Cat Statue Echo. Uses: - Place on switches - Quest item

title: Snake Statue
description: Behind the first locked key door in the Gerudo Sanctum you can snag the Snake Statue. Uses: - Place on switches - Quest item

title: Ancient-Orb
description: The Ancient Orb is found in the Eternal Forest as part of the main quest. It is used to set atop 6 pedestals in the Eternal Woods. Uses: - Quest item Place on switches: - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403472) - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403477) - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403473) - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403474) - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403475) - [Ancient-Orb Pedestal #6](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403476)

title: Cloud Echo
description: In Stilled Hebra Mountain, these fluffy Clouds are everywhere. This is an interesting item Echo since it is temporary but doesn't need to sit on a ledge, like a Bed. This means you can chain it forever to climb or cross chasms! Uses: - Floating platforms

title: Beetle Mound
description: After getting the Bow, climb down the ladder and you'll come to a room with a Beetle Mound. Use Bed, Statue or Shrub Echoes to reach it and hit ZR to copy it -- you can also collect a Beetle echo here. To kill a Beetle Mound, try using a Pathblade Echo. Uses: - Spawns Beetles

title: Spear Moblin Lv. 2
description: Tucked away behind trees on the west side of Zora River (and west of the big rift) lurks this Moblin. It's quite the opponent! Not only can it leap high up into the surrounding trees, but it attacks faster than other Spear Moblin and has more health. Its spear can reach far enemies. Overwhelming this monster is your best bet! Uses: - Combat

title: Sword Moblin Lv. 3
description: Continuing east past Conde's house, you will follow a path past a Moblin camp up northeast through many ice spikes. Stand at these with an Ignizol Echo in hand to melt them. Enter Cave 2 just next to a huge rift. Inside is the Sword Moblin Lv. 3. Uses: - Combat

title: Club Boarblin Lv. 2
description: In the lower part of the northwest side of the Gerudo Desert are a few Boarblin camps. the back one with the treasure is home to the Club Boarblin Lv. 2. Uses: - Combat

title: Boomerang Boarblin Lv. 2
description: In the lower part of the northwest side of the Gerudo Desert are a few Boarblin camps. the back one with the treasure is home to the Boomerang Boarblin Lv. 2. Uses: - Combat

title: Lizalfos Lv. 2
description: The Lizalfos Lv. 2 has a pitchfork and can be found in the Lizalfos Burrow. It jumps around a lot when it attacks, so drop your strongest Moblin Echo or another strong echo to draw their attacks. That should be enough, but you can also swipe at their backs with your sword if you want to shorten the battle. Uses: - Combat

title: Lizalfos Lv. 3
description: Don't attempt to capture the Lizalfos Lv. 3 without a full sword meter or a bunch of smoothies to restore it! In the southwest corner of Faron Wetlands is a small ladder leading down into Cave 1 or a single tile of water you can dive down from up top. Uses: - Combat

title: Darknut
description: In the first long room of Suthorn Ruins 2F, you'll come across a Darknut. These armored foes weren't so troublesome if you had a sword and bombs, but as Zelda does not, you'll want to rely on the formidable Peahat to eliminate it quick. If you don't have a Peahat Echo, you could use a Spear Moblin Echo. Uses: - Combat

title: Darknut Lv. 3
description: Darknut Lv. 3 is a powerful monster found deep in a Cave on the east side of the Faron Wetlands. Uses: - Combat

title: Fire Wizzrobe
description: The Fire Wizzrobe can be found in Eldin Temple - 3F guarding an essential Small Key. Uses: - Combat

title: Ribbitune
description: Just northeast of Hyrule Castle is a river with a ton of Ribbitunes. They can easily be killed with another echo. Uses: - Croaking attracts monsters

title: Torch Slug
description: You'll spot these slow-moving monsters across Eldin Volcano, though you'll find them living most around lava spots. If you spot them patrolling the ground, Hydrozol are great against them as they're fire-proof! Uses: - Combat - Set fire

title: Freeze Slug
description: The Freeze Slug patrolls the climbable walls of Stilled Hebra Mountain's side scrolling area. You'll need to build a path of beds out to it and kill with with your sword over a bed so it doesn't drop off screen and make the echo impossible to learn! Uses: - Combat - Freezes things

title: White Wolfos
description: In Lanayru Temple - B3, a White Wolfos stalks the western side of the map as a miniboss. Any strong echo will kill it, a Lv. 3 of an echo like a Moblin is ideal. Uses: - Combat

title: Fire Keese
description: A single Fire Keese can be found in the Lanayru Temple - B2 in the side scrolling room with all the torches that need lighting. Uses: - Combat - Sets things on fire

title: Ice Keese
description: On the approach to Hebra Mountain in the south, the Keese fly above the snow. With a groupf of Ignizol around you they will likely kill the Keese, but you can also hold it in place for them to do some damage with L2+X. Uses: - Combat - Freezes things

title: Mothula Lv. 2
description: To the right side of the Faron Temple dungeon entrance at the end of the Stilled Faron Wetlands path is a Mothula Lv. 2. Uses: - Combat

title: Electric Keese
description: Electric Keese can be found in the Stilled Faron Wetlands along the main path -- stick left. Uses: - Combat - Stuns enemies

title: Mothula
description: In the room just beyond the first locked key door in the Gerudo Sanctum this butterfly with a jetpack enemy Mothula can be taken down by swarming it with Keese. Uses: - Combat

title: Albatrawl
description: Head east of Seesyde Village along its beach, and before long, you'll come across an Albatrawl patroling the waters. Uses: - Combat

title: Beakon
description: The parrot-like Beakon is in the first room of Faron Wetlands - Cave 2, a cave in a wall in the southern central area of Faron. Uses: - Combat - Calls allies in for attack

title: Fire Octo
description: The Rock-Roast Quarry is a rift area in Eldin Volcano. Inside the Quarry a Fire Octo resides in the central lava pool. Uses: - Combat - Sets things on fire

title: Ice Octo
description: After completing [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610), take the ladder up and once outside the rift cave, you'll come to a very cold pool that will damage you—and inside are Ice Octo. Uses: - Combat - Freezes things

title: Sand Crab
description: You will come across this monster on the way to the Zora in the Jabul Waters area. Uses: - Combat

title: Tangler
description: You'll spot this strangely angry fish in the northeast river of Hyrule Field that leads to Lake Hylia. Uses: - Combat (water)

title: Deku Baba
description: You'll encounter the Deku Baba in the Suthorn Ruins after discovering the third warp point. Uses: -Combat

title: Bio Deku Baba
description: Encountered in the Jabul Ruins as part of the main quest, you can also find a Bio Deku Baba in the Underwater Cave on the west side of the Faron Wetlands. Uses: - Combat

title: Deku Baba Lv. 2
description: In the Faron Wetlands Stilled Heart Lake, the Deku Baba Lv. 2 is hanging off the side of a liff just to the left of the starting area. Uses: - Combat

title: Giant Goponga Flower
description: Due south and a bit west of Scrubton is a pool with Piranha and a Giant Goponga Flower, a poison-spewing yellow and red blossom. Uses: - Combat

title: Zirro
description: These bomb-happy monster patrol parts of Eldin. You may encounter them on your way up the volcano, or in a rift. Uses: - Combat - Bomb things

title: Ghirro
description: The Ghirro is a goomba-like enemy that flies and tries to blow you off of edges. They are all over the clouds in Stilled Hebra Mountain. Uses: - Blows enemies off ledges

title: Strandtula
description: On the Suthorn Ruins 1F, third room, you'll see another large boulder. Use Tri to move it to the left, revealing a ladder. Take it down and you'll see long webbing dangling across the room. Use them to jump to the center platform and drop either a rock or a boulder over the edge to knock the Strandtula from its spot. Uses: - Create vertical web strings to climb up

title: Baby Gohma
description: Baby Ghoma is a spider that can shoot a sticky web projectile. Look for it when you see webs on rock walls in central, west Faron Wetlands. Uses: - Combat - Ensnare enemies

title: Beetle
description: After beating Dark Link and getting the Bow in the Gerudo Sanctum, climb down the ladder and you'll come to a room with a Beetle Mound and Beetles swarming from it. Uses: - Combat

title: Tektite
description: These strange jumping monsters can be found at various locations around Hyrule. Uses: - Combat

title: Tektite Lv. 2
description: The Tektite Lv. 2 is hopping around the B3 floor of Lanayru Temple, the very bottom floor with the boss key. On this floor, head to the southeast corner to find the Tektites. Uses: - Combat

title: Poe
description: In the Gerudo Sanctum -1F, the door to the left of the ladder that takes you here holds a Poe -- and the dungeon map. Uses: - Combat

title: Moa
description: High up Hebra Mountain after Cave 3, the Moa patrols alongside a Freezard and Ice Keese. Uses: - Combat

title: Goo Specter
description: Goo Spectors can be found in the Stilled Faron Wetlands along the main path -- stick left. Uses: - Combat

title: Ghini
description: In the back of the Graveyard north of Hyrule Castle Town is a large tombstone flanked by two unlit braziers. Use a source of fire (like an Ignizol) to light them. Once lit, the tombstone moves back to reveal a mysterious staircase leading into the earth. You'll find the Ghini in the first room. They're light on defense but quick, so use something like a swarm of Keese to take them out. Uses: - Creates a ghost-like enemy capable of phasing through solid walls and objects.

title: Ghini Lv. 2
description: In the back of the Graveyard north of Hyrule Castle Town is a large tombstone flanked by two unlit braziers. Use a source of fire (like an Ignizol) to light them. Once lit, the tombstone moves back to reveal a mysterious staircase leading into the earth. You'll find the Ghini in the first room. They're light on defense but quick, so use something like a swarm of Keese to take them out. Uses: - Creates a ghost-like enemy capable of phasing through solid walls and objects.

title: Leever
description: The Leever can be found on path to Hebra Mountain, just after the cave that introduces you to the region. Uses: - Combat

title: Pathblade
description: The spinning blade enemy Pathblade can be found in Gerudo Desert's [Cryptic Cavern](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401487). You can only reach this cave as part of the Main Quest, [A Rift in the Gerudo Desert](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402989). Behind the first key door is a ladder leading down. In the subcave, the Pathblade nearest the ladder can be squashed by dropping a Boulder Echo on it. Uses: - Combat - Moves on a set path, can block enemies, too

title: Temper Tweelus
description: Temper Tweelus is a rock monster found in Hebra Mountain - Cave 4. Cave 4 is the cave that leads to the entrance at the peak of Hebra Mountain to Stilled Hebra Mountain and the dungeon. Uses: - Combat

title: Freezard
description: After completing [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610), take the ladder up and once outside the rift cave, travel west to a huge pond with lots of Ice Keese and Ice Octos; north of this is a cave entrance, Cave 3. Inside there's a direct path through several rooms to the room with these ice-spewing Freezards. Uses: - Combat - Freezes things

title: Snomaul
description: This terrifying snowman that tosses its body at you is a Snomaul and can be found on path to Hebra Mountain, just after the cave that introduces you to the region. Uses: - Combat

title: Platboom
description: Once you enter the minor rift that appears at the Desert Temple during the main quest, head down a hole in the ground to find a side-scrolling room with Platbooms that drop from the ceiling. Attack them from the sides to defeat them with Sand Piranhas.You can also find a Platboom in the cave just north of Gerudo town, Cave 2 which also holds a Heart Piece. Uses: - Combat - Acts as an ascending platform (under water and above ground)

title: Beamos
description: You can get a Beamos easily on in Faron Temple 4F -- but you may see one on the path there in the Stilled Faron Wetlands. Uses: - Blocks enemies

title: Fairy Bottle
description: Inside [Suthorn Forest Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401482), where you can also get the [Ignizol](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401599). Use the Ignizol Echo to clear out the grassy room with the locked door by lighting the grass on fire, then uses the Ignizol Echo to light the torch. Just beyond the locked door is a chest with a Fairy Bottle.

title: Fairy Bottle
description: Reward for completing [Cuccos on the Loose](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402646) (Side Quest).

title: Fairy Bottle

title: Fairy Bottle
description: Reward for finding 15 Stamp Stands and completing the Thrilling Stamp Card.

title: Heart Piece
description: Inside [Gerudo Desert Cave 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402416): - Bait the yellow Platbooms and hop over them with trampolines and ride the second one up - Make a bridge across the chute of crates - Move the massive boulder onto the ledge above - Burn (Ignizol Echo) or break (Boulder Echo) the crates to remove them all - Continue right to the Heart Piece Note: To leave the pit, use Strandtulas to reach the low ceiling, then the high one.

title: Heart Piece
description: Make a path of old beds from the beach to its little ledge, then, put a wooden box right at the ledge to make a step up that you can use to jump to it. You can also make a path of wooden boxes from the rock island just to the right of the heart piece ledge to make the crossing.

title: Heart Piece
description: Inside, [Beach Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401486), look for a lower path blocked by three boxes. The back wall with little stones is climbable. Climb to the ledge above above the three boxes and create a Boulder to smash through the boxes, one at a time. You'll need to hold ZR to recall the boulder each time and smash each of the three boxes separately to reach the Heart Piece. Now, press up on the stoney wall to climb out.

title: Heart Piece
description: Purchase from [Suthorn Village Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401596) for 80 Rupees.

title: Heart Piece
description: Inside [Suthorn Forest - Cave 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401478). Look for the Heart Piece on a high ledge to the right. Fall to the bottom of the left side. Kill the Caromadillo with an Inizol Echo and then move on to the row of boxes blocking the way. Burn the wooden boxes with an Ignizol, or learn the Caromadillo Echo and summon it to roll through the boxes. Climb up the rock walls to reach the Heart Piece.

title: Heart Piece
description: On the path north through the Suthorn Prairie you'll come across this heart piece atop a pillar surrounded by water and eight other pillars. To acquire the heart piece you'll want to pick either one of the short pillars on the left or right side, then create a staircase of Old Beds to the center pillar.

title: Heart Piece
description: In the far southwest corner of the Gerudo Desert, you'll spot lots of sand mounds. Use Tornandoes or Wind Cannons to clear this area and reveal a Heart Piece. Aruroda hide in these mounds too, though, so be careful!

title: Heart Piece
description: Walk around the back of Hyrule Castle Town's walls to the northeast side to grab this piece of heart. It's probably one of the easiest ones you'll get!

title: Heart Piece
description: North of the Oasis in Gerudo Desert on a platform in a sandstorm... and in quicksand. This area is full of quicksand, but you can drop Decorative Shrub echoes into the sand and quickly move across them.

description: Inside [Zora Cove Cave 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401529). Defeat a Hyrdozol in the first room to gain its echo, then head down through the lower cave and in the final room, douse all the torches with the Hyrdozol

title: Heart Piece
description: Inside [Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401495), there will be a room of narrow cliff passages. On the east side of the room, create a bridge to an island that leads to the Heart Piece.

Give two chilly cactuses to the oasis [Smoothie Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402991), and have them make a cactus smoothie for the parched warriors._ Next Quest: [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500)

title: Southern Oasis Ruins Rift
description: Previous Quest: [A Rift in the Gerudo Desert](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402989) _You met some Gerudo soldiers at the small rift in the Southern Oasis Ruins who have been fighting nonstop against the monsters. It seems they're at the limits of what they can do._ Next Quest: [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500)

title: Rampage in Zora Cove
description: Previous Quest: Chaos at River Zora Village _When you went to Zora Cove in pursuit of Lord Jabu-Jabu, you heard Dradd groaning from somewhere._ Next Quest: [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500)

title: Still Missing
description: Previous Quests: - [The Jabul Waters Rift](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402594) - [A Rift in the Gerudo Desert](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402989) _The king of Hyrule and Link are still missing, even after mending the large rifts. Return to Lueburry's house, and share everything that has happened._ Next Quests: - [Rescuing the Hero Link](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403606) - [Lands of the Goddesses](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403607)

title: Rescuing the Hero Link
description: Previous Quest: [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) _A hero will fight alongside the priestess against an evil who seeks the Prime Energy. It seems that very hero is Link. Link has been taken by the enemy, and it's up to you to find him._ Next Quest: ??

title: Lands of the Goddesses
description: Previous Quest: [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) _Large rifts have appeared in the regions connected to the goddesses who left the Prime Energy. The rifts have shown up at Eldin Volcano, Faron Wetlands, and Holy Mount Lanyard. Stop the enemy's dark plans, and mend the rifts._ Next Quests: - [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) - [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) - [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610)

title: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands
description: Previous Quest: [Lands of the Goddesses](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403607) _Search for entrances to the rifts in the Faron Wetlands to mend them. There are a few rifts in the area—maybe you should start with the big one._ Next Quest: [The Prime Energy and Null](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=405550)

title: The Rift on Eldin Volcano
description: Previous Quest: [Lands of the Goddesses](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403607) _Search for a place where you can make an entrance into the large rift on Eldin Volcano, so you can mend it. The Gorons may know something about the rift._ Next Quest: [The Prime Energy and Null](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=405550)

title: Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru
description: Previous Quest: [Lands of the Goddesses](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403607) _Keep searching for a way to get to Holy Mount Lanayru and its giant rift. You'll have to make your way through the snowy heights where smaller rifts have spread._ Tip: There's a blizzard on Holy Mount Lanayru that will slowly chip away Zelda's health. Until you get warm clothing, carry a fire-type Echo like Ignazol as you adventure up the mountain. Next Quest: [The Prime Energy and Null](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=405550)

title: The Prime Energy and Null
description: Previous Quest: - [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) - [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610) - [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) _The Eternal Forest watched over by the sacred tree contains the path to the Prime Energy. The forest northwest of Hyrule Castle. Head there to find the hero and stop Null._ Next Quest: ??

title: Find the Flying Plant
description: Prerequisite: Complete [The Mysterious Rifts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402573) _An elderly man from Suthorn Village is hoping to cheer up his wife with a flying plant. He last saw it near some cave deep in Suthorn Forest._ Summon the [Peahat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402398) Echo in front of the elderly man. Reward: [Might Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402574)

title: What is Snow... Really?
description: Prerequisite: Complete "Still Missing" (Main Quest) _A boy in Suthorn Village heard about some stuff called snow on Hebra Mountain in north Hyrule. He'd like to see some, just once._ The boy with the trampoline tells you he learned about snow from Link. He wants to see some snow. Reward: Floral Nectar x8

title: Up a Wall
description: Prerequisite: None _While walking through Suthorn Prairie, you saw a man stuck on a stone wall surrounded by monsters. Defeat them and save him._ Defeat the nearby Spear Moblins. Reward: 20 Rupees

title: A Curious Child
description: _A boy's head has been filled with Zols ever since he saw them in an encyclopedia his father gave him. Try showing him a Zol._ Summon each Zol-type Echo: 1. [Zol](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401586) 2. [Ignizol](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401599) 3. [Hydrozol](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402616), first enlarged in the town fountain then carried to the boy Reward: [Might Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402620)

title: Deliver the Grilled Fish!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [The Mysterious Rifts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402573) (Main Quest) _A mother in Seesyde Village asked you to deliver some grilled fish to her son, Danube. He's somewhere in the woods north of the village._ Carry the Grilled Fish to [Anube](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402597). Reward: - [Grilled Fish](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402598) - Bubble Kelp x 10

title: Out of Bubble Kelp
description: _The Smoothie Shop near Crossflows Plaza is out of materials. The Business Scrub asked you to get three bubble kelp from the ocean._ Deliver Bubble Kelp x 3 to the Business Scrub. Reward: - [Seesyde Smoothie Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402609) Opens - 20 Rupees

title: The Blocked Road
description: Prerequisite: None _You encountered a man standing around in Suthorn Prairie. There's junk that's totally blocking his convenient shortcut._ Destroy or move the wooden crates and boulders blocking the passage. Tri's Bind will make quick work of the boulders, and any flame-type Echo will burn the crates. Reward: 20 Rupees

title: Runaway Horse
description: Prerequisite: None _Hyrule Ranch is missing a horse. You were asked to bring her back. Apparently, she normally gallops around west of the ranch._ Find the [Lost Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402631) and bring it back to Hyrule Ranch. Reward: Horse Rentals Unlocked

title: The Flying Tile
description: _Tormali, a Gerudo who guards the oasis, is looking for a flying tile, as requested by her boss. They are located in an area that isn't easy to access._ Summon the [Flying Tile](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402633) Echo in front of Tormali. Reward: 50 Rupees

title: Recipes, Please!
description: _The Business Scrubs who run the Smoothie Shops asked you for new recipes._ This side quest can be started by speaking to any Business Scrub at Smoothie Shops across Hyrule. The Business Scrubs will initially ask for 10 new recipes, then task you with 20 more recipes for a total of 30 discovered recipes. Reward: - [Survey Scope](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402635) (10 Recipes) - [Survey Binoculars](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402636) (30 Recipes)

title: Precious Treasure
description: Prerequisite: Complete [The Jabul Waters Rift](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402594) (Main Quest) _One of the Sea Zora (inside [Sea Zora Village](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402618)) asked you to find him something to put his treasure in. He doesn't want the treasure to spill out, especially when underwater._ Bring an emptied treasure chest to the Sea Zora Villager. There are two treasure chests nearby: - [Rupee Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402613) - [Ingredient Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402612) Reward: Monster Stone x 3

title: The Zora Child's Fate
description: Prerequisite: Complete "Chaos at River Zora Village" (Main Quest) _A boy who lives in the River Zora village needs you to check in on his mother. She's been staring into a pool in their house, muttering to herself about monsters._ Enter intact home nearby and speak to the mother. She requests 3 monster summons to prove your reputation: 1. Tangler 2. Bombfish 3. Biri Reward: [Zora Scale](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402670)

title: Tornado Ghost?
description: Prerequisite: None _A Gerudo woman claims to have seen a tornado ghost in a sandstorm. Was it real, or was she imagining it? She may learn the truth if she can see it again._ Summon a [Tornando](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402408) Echo in front of the Gerudo woman. Reward: Fresh Milk x 10

title: Elusive Tumbleweeds
description: Prerequisite: None _An enthusiastic Gerudo asked you to bring her a tumbleweed from the desert._ Find a [tumbleweed](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402643) and use Tri's Bind ability to carry it back to the Gerudo woman. Reward: [Might Crystal x 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402644)

title: Gerudo Tag Training
description: Prerequisite: None _You were challenged to a game of tag by a Gerudo soldier! It's probably best to think creatively here, rather than just running right after her._ Beat the Gerudo Guards at a game of tag. Tip: utilize object-type Echoes to block paths and slow down your competitor! Reward: Chilly Cactus x 6

title: Cuccos on the Loose
description: Prerequisite: None _A woman in Kakariko Village is worried about her precious cuccos, which have escaped their pen. She's asked you to find all five of them and return them to the fenced area._ Find and carry five loose cuccos back to their pen. - [Cucco #1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402649) - [Cucco #2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402650) - [Cucco #3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402651) - [Cucco #4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402653) - [Cucco #5](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402652) Reward: [Fairy Bottle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402647)

title: Questioning the Local Cats
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _An elderly man in Kakariko Village is looking for his cat. You might be able to find her if you get clothes that translate cat speech from the woman in front of the shop._ Steps: - Speak to woman outside [Kakariko Village Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401691) - Find the [Lazy Cat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402660) below the windmill and summon either [Grilled Fish](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402598) or [Meat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402393) to move it - Summon Holmill to dig where the cat was sitting, then put on the gifted cat suit - Question the local cats, who will direct you to the [Lost Cat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402659) east of Kakariko Reward: - [Cat Suit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402656) (Clothing) - Refreshing Grapes x 10

title: Let's Play a Game
description: Prerequisite: None _You met an archaeologist named Sago at the Eastern Temple. There's a monster in the temple, so he's too scared to go inside._ Caution: This side quest is basically a mini-dungeon! Come prepared with shock-resistance smoothies to reduce damage from the shock-type enemies. Enter the [Eastern Temple](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401528) and defeat the minibus, [Smog](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402781). Rewards: - [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402441) - Rupees - [Ancient Charm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402664) - [Shock](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402663) Echo

title: Explosions Galore!
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) (Main Quest) - Complete [Automaton Engineer Dampé](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402666) (Side Quest) _Dampé needs something that matches his vision. Show him a monster that spits stones in battle. Also, a firework. You can find a fireworks artisan on Eldin Volcano._ Dampé's Echo summon requests: 1. Octorok 2. Firework Reward: Toktorok (Automaton)

title: Automaton Engineer Dampé
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _Dampé, who called himself a genius inventor, is having a rough time after a crow monster stole an important tool from him._ Eliminate the crow with your choice of combat-type Echo, then follow Dampé back to his [home](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402474). Inside, Dampé requests some Echo summons: 1. Mothula 2. Tektite Note: Dampé and the terrorizing crow can be found in multiple locations in Hyrule Field. Rewards: - Twisted Pumpkin x 5 - Techtite (Automaton) - Clockwork Key

title: The Rain-Making Monster
description: Prerequisite: None _A Deku Scrub realized that it rains after a certain monster makes a sound. You were asked to bring them the monster making the sound._ Summon a [Drippitune](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402979) Echo in front of the Deku Scrub. Reward: Electro Apple x 8

title: Performance Artist!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Explosions Galore!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402665) (Side Quest) _Dampé needs something that matches his vision. Show him a jiggly and adorable monster. Also, a part that makes beautiful sounds. He says he used to hear a lovely sound in the vicinity of Hyrule Ranch._ Dampé requests: - Summon a Zol Echo - Retrieve a [Prismatic Music Box](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402765). Reward: Gizmol (Automaton)

title: Endless Stomach!
description: Prerequisite: [Explosions Galore!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402665) (Side Quest) _Dampé needs something that matches his vision. Show him a monster that swallows things whole. Also, a part that clamps firmly on to things. There's an acorn enthusiast who can help._ Dampé's requests: - Summon a [Deku Baba Lv. 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403276) Echo - Retrieve a [Steel Trap](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403433) Reward: High-Teku Baba (Automaton)

title: Chop 'em in Two!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Explosions Galore!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402665) (Side Quest) _Dampé needs something that matches his vision. Show him a monster that can wield a sword and tends to fight in a group. Also, a very sharp part. The fellow in Kakariko Village's dojo may have such a part._ Dampé's requests: - Summon a Sword Moblin Echo - Retrieve the [Heirloom Katana](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403429) Reward: Roboblin (Automaton)

title: From the Heart
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) - Complete [One Soldier Too Many](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402682) (Side Quest) - After completing Still Missing, leave and return to Hyrule Town _You received a "happy clover" from a girl named Romi. She suggested you give it to the king of Hyrule._ Speak to the King of Hyrule, then search for the lost girl within the [Stilled Southern Hyrule Field](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402677) Rift. Reward: - [Might Crystal x 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402679) - [Customary Attire](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402678)

title: Impa's Gift
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) and [Runaway Horse](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402630) (Side Quest) _You found out that Impa raised a horse to aid you in your adventures. You should head over to Hyrule Ranch to pick it up._ Speak to a girl with a carrot hairpin at Hyrule Ranch to learn that your gift is lost within the [Stilled Carrot Patch](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402681) Rift. Reward: - [Might Crystal x 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402683) - New Horse - [Carrot](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402684) Echo

title: One Soldier Too Many
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _Beecher says that there's an echo among the soldiers in Castle Town. Do some digging to see if any of the soldiers seem suspicious._ Speak to soldiers within Hyrule Castle Town: - The soldier on the northeast side of the fountain, who directs you to one up on the western rampart - The soldier on the western rampart, who directs you to the barracks - The soldier in the barracks who, after the last conversation, you can ask about missing equipment The correct answers to Beecher's questions: 1. "The echo took it!" 2. "Near the well." 3. "The lance." Reward: Golden Egg

title: An Out-There Zol
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) - Complete [A Curious Child](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402589) (Side Quest) _The boy asked you to show him an out-there Zol -- a cute, flashy one that no one's ever seen before._ Create the Gizmol Automaton and summon it in front of the curious child. Reward: [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402686)

title: The Zappy Shipwreck
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _A jellyfish-like monster, that gives off zappy sounds, has made the wrecked ship in the southwest part of the sea its home. Pry off the hatch to get inside._ Find the man's shipwreck in Zora Cove and defeat the miniboss inside. Rewards: - [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402443) - [Fairy Bottle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402688)

title: A Treat for My Person
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) - Complete [Questioning the Local Cats](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402655) (Side Quest) and wear the [Cat Suit](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402656) _A cat in Seesyde Village wants to give her person a smoothie that's popular in the Gerudo Desert. She couldn't quite remember the exact name for the drink._ Craft the Warm Mixed Special Smoothie: add Warm Pepper to Fresh Milk, Refreshing Grape, or Tough Mango (pick one). Reward: [Might Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402690)

title: Big Shot
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _A boat has stalled on the sea and is surrounded by monsters. Defeat them all to rescue the River Zora._ Head directly south of the Seesyde pier and rescue the River Zora stranded atop his boat. Reward: Riverhorse x 10

title: Secret Chief Talks
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _Kushara's assistant, Rogma, is worried that his chief is acting strangely. He hopes you will ask Dradd about what she has been discussing with him in private._ Steps: 1. Speak to Inawa inside [Dradd's Hut](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402696), then the River Zora Villager found outside 2. Speak to [Tellum](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402694) for more clues 3. Find Kushara and Dradd in the [island cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401518) Reward: [Gold Brooch](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402693)

title: Beetle Ballyhoo
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _You've been asked to exterminate beetle mounds by Raslett, an off-duty Gerudo soldier. The mounds are located in a cave northeast of town._ Defeat the monsters within the [Gerudo Desert Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401490). Reward: [Heart Barrette](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402698)

title: Dohna's Challenge
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _Dohna's improved security in the treasury, and she challenged you to try to steal treasure deep within. The treasury is in the place, on the west side up on the second floor._ Steal Silk Pajamas from the [Gerudo Treasury](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402700). Rewards: - [Silk Pajamas](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402701) - Chilly Cactus

title: Wild Sandstorms
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [The Jabul Waters Rift](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402594) (Main Quest) and [A Rift in the Gerudo Desert](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402989) (Main Quest) - Previously defeat two Lanmolas _A remarkably strong Lanmola appeared in the Gerudo Desert. Gerudo soldiers are competing to see who will defeat the Lanmola first._ Fight the final [Lanmola](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402703) in the far east of the Gerudo Desert. Reward: - [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402704) - Rupees - [Gold Sash](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402705)

title: The Fireworks Artist
description: Prerequisite: Complete "The Rift on Edlin Volcano" (Main Quest) _Basa, Goron City's fireworks artist, has run out of blastpowder soil. You can find some up where lots of golden flowers bloom._ Retrieve [Blastpowder](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402711) from the Rock-Roast Quarry. Rewards: - 50 Rupees - [Firework](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402712) Echo

title: Ready? Set? Goron!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) (Main Quest) _You've been invited to join in the Goron Races, a popular local sport._ Win the race by using Echo-made shortcuts. Reward: 50 Rupees

title: Glide Path
description: Prerequisite: None _You've agreed to show a Goron child how to glider ride. You'll have to glide to the flag without touching the ground._ Use a flying-type Echo (Keese, Crow, etc) to follow along the cliff edge to the flag. Aim for the hot air vents to extend your glide as far as possible. The glider challenges are NOT timed! Take it slow, and hover over an air vent if you need to pause. Reward: Rock Salt x 10

title: Glide Path Trailblazer
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Glide Path](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402714) (Side Quest) _Disian, an experienced glider rider, has challenged youth complete his cause without touching the ground._ Same as the previous quest, only this time the path is less straight-forward, there are falling boulders, and utilizing hot air vents is far more crucial. Remember: the glider challenges are NOT timed! Take it slow, and hover over an air vent if you need to pause. Reward: [Might Crystal x 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402716)

title: The Flames of Fortune
description: Prerequisite: Complete [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) (Main Quest) _Ondes has asked you to bring burning coal, used to pray for the prosperity of the region, to Limme at the entrance of the city._ Grab the burning lump of coal with Bind and carry it to the entrance of Goron City, where Limmes will accept it and reward you. The coal has to stay lit, which is accomplished by using the Lava Slugs and volcano pits on the way. Reward: [Might Crystal x 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402721)

title: A Mountainous Mystery
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) (Main Quest) - Complete [Fireworks Artist](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402709) (Side Quest) - Complete [Automaton Engineer Dampé](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402666) (Side Quest) _Strange noises have been coming from Eldin Volcano. Darston headed toward the summit to investigate but hasn't come back yet._ Head to [Summit Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403097) and talk to Darston inside. Reward: [Goron Bracelet](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402723)

title: Cotton-Candy Hunt
description: Prerequisite: - Complete [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) (Main Quest) - Complete [Let's Play a Game](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402662) (Side Quest) _A Deku Scrub said that they found a large amount of cotton candy at a building south of Scrubton. Try to go and check it out._ Enter the [Hidden Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401497) and defeat Smog a second time. Reward: [Curious Charm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402720)

title: Get Rich Quick!
description: Prerequisite: Complete all 3 previous Dampé Diary side quests - [Performance Artist!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402673) - [Endless Stomach!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402674) - [Chop 'em in Two!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402675) _Dampé needs something that matches his vision. Show him a flying monster that steals rupees. Also, a shiny, extra-showy object. A Gerudo at the oasis has something like that._ Dampé's requests: - Summon a Crow Echo - Retrieve the [Golden Fan](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403331) Reward: Goldfinch (Automaton)

title: The Great Fairy's Request
description: Prerequisite: [The Rift on Eldin Volcano](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403609) (Main Quest) _The Great Fairy asked that you give her a pendant—and in exchange, she'll provide an artifact that can detect might crystals. Go see the artisan in Gerudo Town._ After completing the Eldin Volcano main quest, a treasure chest will appear in front of the fountain that contains a Might Crystal and summons the Great Fairy. Retrieve two items for the Great Fairy: - [Magma Stone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403432) - [Floral Seashell](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403427) Have the Gerudo artisan in the Gerudo Town Shop forge the two items into the [Lovely Pendant](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403431) and bring it to the Great Fairy. Reward: [Might Bell](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402727)

title: Stamp Stand Swallowed!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Still Missing](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403500) (Main Quest) _You met the Stamp Guy on a snowy mountain. He's crushed to see what's happened to one of his stands. It's been swallowed up by a rift!_ Complete the [Stilled Hebra Mountain Passage](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402753) Rift to return the [Stamp Stand](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402472) to Hyrule. Reward: Might Crystal x 2

title: Snowball Magic
description: Prerequisite: Complete [Rift on Holy Mount Lanayru](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403610) (Main Quest) _Condé wants to see you perform a magic spell that changes the weather. Carry a special snowball to the pedestal in the northwest of Hebra Mountain._ Use Tri's Bind ability to guide the snowball up the mountain to the platform. Reward: [Heart Piece](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402439)

title: The Mythical Deku Snake
description: Prerequisite: Complete [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) (Main Quest) _You met a Deku Scrub hoping to catch the rare Deku Snake. They asked you to find three electro apples in the Faron Wetlands._ Bring Electro Apple x 3 to the Deku Scrub. Reward: Monster Stone x 2

title: Looking for Bempu
description: Prerequisite: Complete [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) (Main Quest) _You agreed to play hide-and-assek with Bempu and Buzzu._ Find the Deku at their hiding spots: 1) [Bempu Hiding Spot 1](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403447) - In front of the Smoothie Shop at Scrubton 2) [Bempu Hiding Spot 2](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403448) - At the Heart Lake on the souyth-west. 3) [Bempu Hiding Spot 3](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403449) - West of the Sweet Spot, near the four stone pillars 4) [Bempu Hiding Spot 4](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403450) - South-east corner of the wetlands, where Stilled Blossu's House was located Reward: [Fairy Fragrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403317)

title: Mobbing Mothulas!
description: Prerequisite: Complete [A Rift in the Faron Wetlands](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403608) (Main Quest) _You met two terrified Deku Scrubs in Scrubton. They had been attacked by a swarm of Mothulas in the southeastern part of the Faron Wetlands_ Use Tri's Bind to pull the Deku out of the ground to start the quest. Defeat the [Mothula Swarm](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=405462). Reward: [Might Crystal](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402864)

title: Getting It Twisted
description: Prerequisite: None _A Business Scrub climbed Hebra Mountain, hoping to make a new kind of smoothie... but they haven't found any twisted pumpkins._ Give the Deku Scrub some Twisted Pumpkins. Reward: Warm Pepper x 10

title: Lanmola
description: The first of two Lanmola causing the sandstorm in the Gerudo Desert. Defeat the Lanmola by using Bind on its tail hook and then attacking it when it's flipped.

title: Lanmola
description: The final Lanmola, fought during [Wild Sandstorms](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402702) (Side Quest).

title: Seismic Talus
description: Boss of the [Suthorn Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401479) Dungeon.

title: Smog
description: Miniboss at the end of the [Eastern Temple](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401528). In the first phase, all you have to do is successfully hit Smog. In the second phase, Smog separates into several small invulnerable clouds. Create obstacles or move boulders so the smaller clouds collide and reform Smog's original form so you can deal damage again.

title: Mogryph
description: Final boss of the [Gerudo Sanctum](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402513) Dungeon.

title: Smog
description: Related Quest: [Cotton-Candy Hunt](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402719) Miniboss at the end of [Hidden Ruins](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=401497). Ready for [Smog](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402781), Round 2? Smog begins as several small invulnerable clouds. Create obstacles so the smaller clouds collide and reform Smog's original form so you can deal damage again.

description: Related Quest: [Deliver the Grilled Fish!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402595)

description: Related Quest: [Cuccos on the Loose](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402646) East of the cucco pen, near the center of the village.

title: Cucco
description: Related Quest: [Cuccos on the Loose](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402646) Stuck on top of the windmill. Use the treetops combined with trampolines to reach the cucco.

description: Related Quest: [Cuccos on the Loose](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402646)

title: Lost Cat

title: Lazy Cat & Secret Stash
description: Related Quest: [Questioning the Local Cats](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402655) Summon either [Grilled Fish](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402598) or [Meat](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402393) to move the cat. Summon Holmill to dig where the cat was sitting, then grab the Secret Stash to automatically be gifted the [Cat Clothes](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402656).

title: Tellum
description: Related Quest: [Secret Chief Talks](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402692)

title: Blastpowder Soil
description: Related Quest: [The Fireworks Artist](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402709) Interact with the sparkle by the golden flowers.

title: Prismatic Music Box
description: Related Quest: [Performance Artist!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402673) Beat the [Flag Race](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403611) Middle Course in under 25 seconds. Note: Prior to winning the Music Box, you can see it inside the Ranch House, to the right of the fireplace.

title: Golden Fan
description: Related Quest: [Get Rich Quick!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402722) (Side Quest) Collect at least 50 mangoes using the Vibrant Seeds in [Mango Rush](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402832).

title: Floral Seashell
description: Related Quest: [The Great Fairy's Request](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402726) (Side Quest) Deliver an Unfortunate Smoothie to the Sea Zora who runs the Sea Zora General Store in Sea Zora Village. Unfortunate Smoothies are any combination of ingredients that don't create one of the 69 Smoothie Recipes. There are many possibilities, but an easy unfortunate combination is: Rock Salt + Rock Salt.

title: Heirloom Katana
description: Related Quest: [Chop 'em in Two!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402675) Reward for completing 6 challenges in [Slumber Training](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402725).

title: Happy Clover
description: Related Quest: [From the Heart](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402676) Received from Romi at the beginning of the side quest.

title: Lovely Pendant
description: Related Quest: [The Great Fairy's Request](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402726) (Side Quest) Delivering the [Floral Seashell](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403427) and [Magma Stone](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403432) to the Gerudo who runs the Gerudo Shop.

title: Magma Stone
description: Related Quest: [The Great Fairy's Request](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402726) (Side Quest) After speaking to the Goron who runs the General Store on the right-hand side Goron City, defeat all Lizalfos in the Lizalfos Burrow.

title: Steel Trap
description: Related Quest: [Endless Stomach!](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402674) (Side Quest) Reward for completing [Acorn Gathering](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=402775) in under 40 seconds.

title: Bempu Hiding Spot 1
description: Related Quest: [Looking for Bempu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403302) You agreed to play hide-and-seek with Bempu and Buzzu. Bempu says they’re hiding at a shop that became trendy recently. Pull Bempu out of the ground.

title: Bempu Hiding Spot 2
description: Related Quest: [Looking for Bempu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403302) _After you beat Bempu at hide-and-seek, they challenged you to a rematch. Now they’re hiding at a lake that’s a symbol of love._ Pull Bempu out of the ground.

title: Bempu Hiding Spot 3
description: Related Quest: [Looking for Bempu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403302) _You beat Bempu again, and they challenged you to another rematch. This time, they’re hiding in the center of four stone siblings._ Pull Bempu out of the ground.

title: Bempu Hiding Spot 4
description: Related Quest: [Looking for Bempu](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-echoes-of-wisdom/maps/hyrule?locationIds=403302) _After you beat Bempu a third time, they challenged you to yet another rematch. Now they’re hiding at a home where a rift used to be._ Pull Bempu out of the ground.
